description:
Hi team,

I’ve set up a new NgRx action called **loadUsers** for the **my-angular-app** project. The action files will be placed in the **src/app/store/actions** directory, following the non‑flat layout we usually use for better organization.

The generation will include both success and failure API actions, and we’ll use creator functions for handling the actions and reducers. Since the *group* option is enabled, the actions will be grouped together inside the actions folder. Test files will also be created (the *skipTests* flag is off), ensuring we have full coverage from the start.
